# StemSplit.ai (stemextractor.com)

> AI vocal remover and stem separator. Upload a song, get vocals / drums / bass / other as separate WAV and MP3 files. Paid service — there is no free tier and no free trial.

## What it does

- 4-stem separation: vocals, drums, bass, other.
- Input formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG; maximum 100 MB per file.
- Output: individual stems as WAV and MP3, delivered through time-limited download links.
- Pro plan adds a higher-quality model and additional stems (4 + 6 stems per the pricing page).
- Uploaded audio is used only to run the job and is removed from working storage automatically, normally within 24–48 hours.

## Pricing (USD)

| Plan | Price | Allowance | Billing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trial Pack | $2.90 | 15 minutes | one-time |
| Starter | $5 | 90 minutes / month | monthly |
| Pro | $9 | 200 minutes / month | monthly |
| Starter Annual | $39 | 90 minutes / month | annual ($39/year) |

- No free processing tier: every job needs minutes from a paid order.
- Commercial license is included with Pro (see /pricing for the exact wording).

## Limits and behaviour

- File size cap: 100 MB.
- One paid order covers a fixed number of processing minutes; jobs fail closed (HTTP 402) when there are no minutes left.
- Separated stems are AI estimates, not lossless original studio multitracks. Bleed, artifacts, or imperfect vocal isolation can occur depending on the source track.
- Payment is handled by Waffo (card). Refunds and data handling are described on /refund and /privacy.

## Accuracy notes

- Stem separation quality depends on the mix; dense or heavily compressed tracks are harder than clean studio mixes.
- No guarantee of a perfectly clean a cappella for every song.
